candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the internship in Data Engineering. Connecting sources, building reliable pipelines and data models, and turning them into dashboards for company KPIs is exactly what I did in my previous roles, and I would love to do it for a European launch vehicle.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. I worked in SAP data and analytics at TallyMarks Consulting and as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea.

achievements.impact: I designed and implemented SAP Datasphere data pipelines and rebuilt a manufacturer's datasets end to end during a 42-dashboard migration
I built data models from ABAP CDS view sources and joins, KPI dashboards on top of them, and documented sources, calculations and results for each
I built DocuMind, a Python application with a FastAPI REST API, 37 unit tests, GitHub Actions CI and Docker

letter.problems_section: I would integrate sources into your warehouse, help keep pipelines healthy, build tested models and dashboards and document metrics so others can trust them. I have not used dlt, dbt or Metabase yet, but moving from SAP BW to SAP Datasphere showed me I learn new data tools quickly from documentation.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to the Munich area and can start immediately. As a non-EU student I will agree the internship hours with you so they fit my permitted working days. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
